ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, \(CM\) is the median of \(\triangle ABC\), and \(AM=4\,cm\), what is the length of \(BM\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $CM$ is the median of $\triangle ABC$ and $AM=4\text{cm}$, \\
therefore $BM=AM=4\text{cm}$,\\
so $BM=\boxed{4\text{cm}}$
